definitions.gloss: counter word, counter suffix, numerical classifier
definitions.explanation: A grammatical term for the suffixes attached to numbers when counting things in Japanese. Different counters are used depending on what is being counted — flat things, long things, people, animals, etc. Also called {数|かぞ}え{方|かた} informally.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{助数詞|じょすうし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
{助数詞|じょすうし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{使|つか}い{方|かた}→使い方：07797_tsukaikata⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{外国人|がいこくじん}→外国人：02869_gaikokujin⟧⟦にとって→にとって：06803_nitotte⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: The use of counter words is difficult for foreigners.

examples.japanese: ⟦{正|ただ}しい→正しい：00893_tadashii⟧{助数詞|じょすうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}える→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦ようになる→ようになる：28408_youninaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧より⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{聞|き}こえる→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧。
examples.english: When you can use the correct counter words, your Japanese will sound more natural.

notes:
A linguistic term that learners of Japanese encounter frequently. Common counters include ⟦{枚|まい}→〜枚：00650_mai⟧ (flat things), {本|ほん} (long things), ⟦{匹|ひき}→匹：00939_hiki⟧ (small animals), ⟦{冊|さつ}→〜冊：00666_satsu⟧ (books), {台|だい} (machines/vehicles), and ⟦{杯|はい}→杯：00933_hai⟧ (cups/glasses). Knowing which counter to use with which object is one of the distinctive challenges of Japanese.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {助数詞|じょすうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ (to use a counter word)
- {助数詞|じょすうし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧ (to learn counter words)
- {助数詞|じょすうし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一覧|いちらん}→一覧：17694_ichiran⟧ (list of counter words)
